description: This Go source file provides functions for handling image orientation based on EXIF data, including reading image orientation tags and adjusting image orientation accordingly.

classes.name: fwSeeker
classes.description: A helper struct implementing io.Reader and io.Seeker for forward-only reading and seeking within an input stream.

methods.name: MakeImageUpright
methods.description: Adjusts the image orientation based on the provided EXIF orientation value.

methods.name: GetImageOrientation
methods.description: Reads image data to determine the EXIF orientation tag, supporting JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and WebP formats.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the underlying io.Reader, updating the current position.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks forward in the input stream; only supports forward seeking.
